findings.summary: The decision-link `line` is set to the wrong line, and the test that checks it is missing from the dependents list
findings.evidence: Step 10 sets `line` to "the line of the D171 heading". In the existing file, the D160 link has `line = 4443` (docs/decision-links.toml:189), but the D160 heading is at docs/decisions.md:4435. Line 4443 is the '- **Decision:** Amends D08 in prose only...' bullet. `Link::matches` (crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs:56) requires `self.line == hit.line`, where a hit is the parsed 'Amends Dxx' phrase. The repo test `the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list` (crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs:115-133) fails on any listed link that is not found, and on any parsed hit that is not listed. The plan's wording for D171, 'D08 was checked and stands', may also not parse as a hit. The dependents entry names only the decision gate and the mirror tests, not backtest.rs, the reader of decision-links.toml that checks this field. Fix: Say that D171's Decision bullet must contain the amendment phrase the parser recognises ('Amends D08 in prose only: D08 was checked for the candidate.rs change and stands', copying D160). Set `line` to the line of that phrase, not the heading. Add crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs (`cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test backtest`) to the dependents and to criterion 7's run.
findings.location: Plan steps 9-10, Files: docs/decision-links.toml; Dependents: 'Change to a path D08 governs'

findings.summary: The plan does not show the brief text fitting the existing producer report instructions in prompts/producer.md, which list the report fields
findings.evidence: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md names report fields such as `unchanged_planned_files`, so the prompt explains individual fields. The plan leaves prompts unchanged (in line with the out-of-scope list) and relies on the brief section plus the schema doc comment. That works. But the brief already says 'A run that changes nothing in this directory fails as an empty candidate' (briefs.rs:719, 731), and the plan does not say how the new section relates to that sentence. Fix: In step 5, place the no_change section so that it, or the existing empty-candidate sentence, says the run still fails but the reason is recorded. One instruction is enough; don't contradict the existing sentence.
findings.location: Dependents: 'Description of the producer report fields'; Step 5

findings.summary: The plan sets aside the information-giving half of introspection 7whw, not only its refusal half
findings.evidence: The request says to prefer giving the stage information. Introspection 7whw proposed resolving the named source symbol before dispatch. Used as information (telling the producer, in its brief, that the symbol or target already holds the item) rather than as a refusal, that would also be an information fix. The plan treats the whole idea as a refusal rule. The accepted reading puts the pre-dispatch check out of scope, so this is not a plan error, but the CHANGELOG and D171 wording should not say it can only be a refusal. Fix: In D171's Alternatives, say the pre-dispatch check was declined as out of scope for this reading. Note that an informational form (stating the fact in the producer brief) is a possible follow-up, rather than calling it inherently a refusal rule.
Step 4 says a blank detail reads 'no detail given'. Demonstration 2 asserts 'gave no detail'. Fix: Pick one wording and use it in both places.

summary: I read the code the plan names and checked its claims. They hold. candidate_stage builds the bare reason at candidate.rs:138-149, and build_candidate puts the report into `candidate.producer_report`. ProducerOutput has deny_unknown_fields, so the new tests would fail on the base commit as the plan says. redact_report (mod.rs:2482-2539) and reading.rs:3862 are the only ProducerReport literals. The retry.rs seam exists: Scenario.report, script(), run_retry and the idle-producer test at retry.rs:840. The producer loop takes an empty-diff report straight to candidate_stage without a send-back unless a criterion is unmet (producer.rs:440-497). The approach is the information fix the request prefers: the brief asks for the outcome, the record keeps it, the reason shows it, and no refusal rule is added. It is sound. One major finding: the decision-link step sets `line` to the D171 heading. The backtest test `the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list` matches links on the line of the 'Amends D08' phrase (D160's link is line 4443, its heading 4435). The dependents list omits that test, so cargo test would fail unless the producer catches it. The other findings are minor wording and placement fixes.
